title: From Evaluation to Evolution: Benchmarking Image Editing and Evolving Image Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.41210v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-world image editing requires coordinating multiple visual transformations with content preservation and reference constraints, yet aggregate scores can readily obscure unmet local requirements. Effective evaluation must therefore identify local failures and translate them into priorities for subsequent model improvement. We introduce WeGenEditBench, comprising 2,740 evaluation instances and 148 task types across single-image, text-intensive, and multi-reference editing. Pre-generated checklists shared across models decompose each request into atomic requirements; item-level deductions and visual evidence are established first and then summarized into scores for edit execution, preservation, visual quality, and task-specific correctness. translated_title: 从评估到进化：图像编辑基准测试与图像模型的演化
translated_abstract: 现实世界的图像编辑需要在保持内容完整性与满足参考约束的前提下协调多种视觉变换，然而总体评分很容易掩盖未满足的局部需求。因此，有效的评估必须能够识别局部失败，并将其转化为后续模型改进的优先事项。我们提出了WeGenEditBench，包含2,740个评估实例和148种任务类型，涵盖单图像编辑、文本密集型编辑和多参考编辑。跨模型共享的预生成清单将每个请求分解为原子化需求；首先建立条目级的扣分和视觉证据，然后将其汇总为编辑执行、内容保持、视觉质量和任务特定正确性四个维度的评分。为了支持递归自我改进（RSI）中的经验获取环节，我们开发了WeGenEvoStudio，这是一个面向RSI学习的统一多智能体框架，集成了模型条件……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了WeGenEditBench图像编辑基准，通过清单式原子需求分解实现细粒度局部失败评估（2,740个实例、148种任务类型），并配套WeGenEvoStudio多智能体框架，支持图像编辑模型的递归自我改进。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces WeGenEditBench, a checklist-based image editing benchmark with 2,740 instances and 148 task types for fine-grained local failure evaluation, paired with WeGenEvoStudio, a unified multi-agent harness that supports recursive self-improvement (RSI) of image editing models.
